title: ALMA Observations of Molecular Gas in the Host Galaxy of AT2018cow
question: What are the molecular gas and star-formation properties of the host galaxy CGCG 137-068 and the local AT2018cow site, and do they favor a massive-star explosion or a TDE progenitor?

what.value: Stellar mass and SFR of CGCG 137-068

evidence.quote: Both the stellar mass ($M_{\rm star}$) and star formation rate (SFR) values are taken from (cite: Perley:2019aa)
the atomic gas mass ($M_{\rm atom}$) is from (cite: Roychowdhury:2019aa)
with those of xGASS (cite: Catinella:2018aa) and xCOLD-GASS galaxies (cite: Saintonge:2017aa) at similar redshifts

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, uvcontsub, tclean mosaic cube with auto-multithresh

recipe.goal: Derive H2 column density and gas surface density at the AT2018cow site
recipe.method: Convert CO intensity to K via Rayleigh-Jeans and apply Galactic XCO
assumptions: Milky Way XCO justified by solar or super-solar metallicity

recipe.goal: Derive total molecular gas mass and compare with xGASS/xCOLD-GASS
recipe.method: Integrated CO luminosity to Mmol with Galactic XCO; combine with literature Mstar, SFR, Matom; compare scaling relations

evidence.quote: The H$_2$ column density at the AT2018cow site is estimated to be $8.6\times10^{20}$ cm$^{-2}$
$M_{\rm mol}/M_{\rm star}$, SFE(mol), and $M_{\rm mol}/M_{\rm atom}$ of CGCG 137-068 are $0.13$

not_stated_but_needed: Aperture/region and velocity range used to integrate I_CO and total flux
How the 6 arcsec site-level N(H2) was measured (aperture)
Method for SFE definitions and SFE(gas)
Line ratio / CO-to-H2 formula for L'CO to Mmol (helium inclusion)
Whether the two executions were combined and the calibrators used
missing_for_reproduction: Flux integration aperture and velocity range
score_reason: Imaging parameters mostly given but aperture and integration choices are missing; short letter.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival data, mostly complete imaging recipe, numeric results (Mmol, N(H2)).
